QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] A Letter to His Wife
QuestInfo.0: Destonen has something to say to you.
QuestInfo.1:
Destonen asked that you deliver a letter to his wife, Yuris, who is almost due to give birth.

#r(If you leave during the quest, you can reset the quest by forfeiting and accepting it again.)
QuestInfo.2:
You went to the Camp Entrance to deliver the letter per Destonen's request, but Yuris wasn't there. There was only a black ribbon fluttering in the wind that someone tied to the mushroom which was serving as an umbrella.
You looked around the camp in haste. Tess was gone and Kyrin had been born.

default.0: Deliver the letter to my wife in #bCamp Entrance#k.

0.msg: Return to the present and ask #bKyrin#k in the #bNavigation Room#k about Tess.
